observation_1.description: Rolling hills covered in patches of green grass and sparse woodlands with thin, scattered trees. The terrain rises and falls gently, offering a wide view of the surrounding area under a clear, sunny sky with a gentle breeze.

observation_2.description: A small stream with clear, flowing water, producing a faint trickling sound. It cuts through the hills, visible from a short distance, and appears clean and accessible.
observation_2.location: Near starting area in rolling hills

observation_3.description: Scattered wild fruits on low branches and shrubs, some colorful and distinct in shape, though their edibility is uncertain. The quantity appears slightly reduced after foraging.

observation_4.description: Natural overhangs in the hills and dense shrubs that could provide cover or temporary shelter. They look sturdy enough to protect against mild weather or hide from wildlife.

observation_5.description: Small herbivores like rabbits or deer and various birds moving through the area. They seem slightly disturbed by human presence, occasionally pausing or fleeing at sudden movements.
